headline: XRP Falls 10% as Long Bets Unwind and ETF Assets Drop Below $1 Billion
summary: XRP fell 10% during a weekend cryptocurrency sell-off, breaking its previous November lows. The drop was driven by long position liquidations as total assets in XRP ETFs fell below $1 billion.
why: XRP is one of the largest cryptocurrencies by market valuation. Leverage liquidations and fund flows in crypto ETFs serve as key indicators of market sentiment and liquidity.

impacts.name: XRP
impacts.why: XRP price declined 10% amid long position liquidations and declining ETF asset totals.
